title: VM1 'unsure' mode: route to a wide-ranging VM2 prompt, send TG#2, terminate flow (operator 2026-09-18: 'create a PRD that would do that process')
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-18, post US-050d landing)
trigger: Operator 2026-09-18 (verbatim): 'I like that there's an unsure mode. VM two can do a best guess at what it is. The prompt would need to be pretty wide ranging to give VM to the ability to use. It's full capabilities to identify what it is that is moving in the frame then that output should be provided for TG two and the flow dropped at that point. So create a PRD, that would do that process. I don't think card 50 G needs to be run.' US-050d (done) added 'unsure' as a valid gate-output mode in infra/vm1_prompt.py:14 and rendered an unsure-friendly caption in telegram_formatter/detail.py:181-185, but the live listener crashes on this branch with `VisionAnalyzerError: unknown detail_class mode 'unsure'; expected one of ['animal', 'person', 'vehicle']` at infra/vision_analyzer.py:100-103 (DISPATCH table missing 'unsure'). Two tracebacks in logs/daemon.log: 2026-09-18 01:44:04 and 04:59:53. The crash swallows VM2 output, drops TG#2, and the alert is silently lost. Per operator, the unsure flow's correct behavior is: (a) VM2 receives a wide-ranging prompt (full latitude to identify what's moving in the frame — no forced class constraints), (b) VM2 output goes to TG#2, (c) flow terminates at TG#2 (no VM3, no per-class matching, no TG#3, no record_hit unless we want it for unsure — see goal).
background: Current state in /Users/jill/farm-surveillance-v2: VM1 emits 'unsure' as a valid gate mode (infra/vm1_prompt.py:14, US-050d). VM2 dispatch is a strict dispatch table in infra/vision_analyzer.py:100-103 mapping mode -> (response_format, prompt_fn) for {vehicle, person, animal}. The 'unsure' key is absent, so detail_class() raises VisionAnalyzerError. The error is caught one frame up in listener/daemon.py:294 (try/except around the pipeline stages) which logs `error=str(e)` and returns HTTP 200 to the camera. The alert is fully dropped: no VM2 output, no TG#2, no TG#3, no record_hit. Operator's directive: instead of crashing, the unsure flow should produce a best-guess identification via a wide-ranging VM2 prompt and send TG#2 with that output, then terminate. There is no further dispatch because unsure cannot meaningfully be matched to enrolled vehicles/persons/animals — the class is by definition uncertain. Per US-050d, telegram_formatter/detail.py:181-185 already renders the unsure branch of build_detail_message(). Once vision_analyzer.py is fixed to dispatch unsure, that renderer is reachable. The flow-termination requirement means listener/daemon.py:295-310 must skip stage_perform_match and stage_build_tg3 when mode='unsure'.
goal: When VM1 returns class='unsure': (1) VM2 receives a wide-ranging prompt with no forced schema class constraint — VM2 has full latitude to describe what it sees (species/breed/color/object/activity) in free-form text plus structured fields it considers useful (class_guess, confidence, reason, description); (2) VM2's output is rendered to TG#2 via telegram_formatter/detail.py:181-185 (already done by US-050d); (3) the flow TERMINATES at TG#2 — stage_perform_match is skipped (no vehicle/person/animal matching candidates apply), stage_build_tg3 is skipped, no record_hit fires; (4) the existing /alert route still returns HTTP 200 to the camera so we don't trigger retry storms; (5) the daemon logs `flow_terminated reason=unsure` at INFO level for operator audit. The 'unsure' branch is the ONLY mode that terminates at TG#2; vehicle/person/animal continue to TG#3 as today.

operator_guarantees.no_residue: After all stories land: infra/vision_analyzer.py:100-103 DISPATCH table has an 'unsure' entry alongside vehicle/person/animal. infra/unsure_prompt.py exists with build_unsure_prompt() + SCHEMA_JSON exported, mirroring the shape of vehicle_prompt.py/person_prompt.py/animal_prompt.py. listener/daemon.py:295-310 has an explicit `if mode == 'unsure': flow terminates at TG#2` branch with stage_perform_match + stage_build_tg3 gated off. No `from infra.vehicle_prompt import` accidentally routes unsure-mode to vehicle. No `_MODES` constant in detail.py is missing 'unsure'.
operator_guarantees.behavior: Given VM1 emits mode='unsure', the listener sends TG#2 with VM2's free-form identification, returns HTTP 200 to the camera, does NOT call stage_perform_match, does NOT call stage_build_tg3, does NOT call record_hit. Vehicle/person/animal modes are unchanged. Verified by tests/test_unsure_v2_dispatch.py (US-051c).
operator_guarantees.schema_match: infra/unsure_prompt.SCHEMA_JSON is a JSON Schema dict compatible with the _response_format(...) wrapper used by all other VM2 prompts. Top-level keys: class_guess (string|null), confidence (number|null), reason (string|null), description (string|null), notable_details (array of strings|null). All fields nullable; VM2 never invents fields, sets null on unobservable values (mirrors vehicle/person/animal conventions).
operator_guarantees.prompt_shape: build_unsure_prompt() returns a prompt that gives VM2 wide latitude: it describes the cropped frame pair, mentions the motion-diff overlay is also attached, and instructs VM2 to provide its best identification without forcing a class constraint. The prompt explicitly says 'you may return null for fields you cannot determine' to prevent fabrication. No enum constraint on class_guess — the model picks any word it considers best.
operator_guarantees.termination_audit: Every unsure-mode alert leaves exactly one INFO log line in logs/daemon.log: `flow_terminated reason=unsure alert_id=<id> camera_id=<cid> vm2_class_guess=<...|null>` so the operator can grep for the new behavior end-to-end. The line is emitted AFTER TG#2 is dispatched.

shipping_definition.all_stories_done: Every story in stories[] has status='done' in this PRD JSON AND `hermes kanban --board coder-farm-surveillance list --status done` shows the corresponding t_<hex> id. Verified by Step 6 verifier: kanban:done + PRD:done + main:code (the worker commits land on a code/v2-051* branch which ff-merges into main before the card flips done).
shipping_definition.smoke_test: scripts/smoke_alert_native.py exits 0 with classification=vehicle|person|animal (no regression on existing paths). A new scripts/smoke_alert_unsure.py runs an artificial 'unsure' webhook and asserts (a) HTTP 200 returned, (b) one Telegram TG#2 message dispatched, (c) zero stage_perform_match calls, (d) zero stage_build_tg3 calls, (e) one INFO log line matching `flow_terminated reason=unsure`. The smoke_alert_unsure.py script is committed.
shipping_definition.no_fallback: If the worker hits a context-window overflow, schema-validation failure, or any other runtime block, the dispatch path does NOT silently substitute CPU for CoreML, does NOT default to vehicle mode for unsure alerts, does NOT skip VM2 and dispatch TG#2 with no payload. The listener must either (a) succeed with a real VM2 result OR (b) raise the existing VisionAnalyzerError so the operator sees the failure.
shipping_definition.branch_hygiene: The card lands a single code/v2-051x-<slug> branch per story. Squash-merge is forbidden; ff-merge into main is required. No uncommitted scratch files (_verify_*.py, _min_*.py) on the worktree at handoff. Verified by `git status --porcelain` returning 0 rows post-merge.

stories.notes: Mirror the shape of infra/vehicle_prompt.py and infra/person_prompt.py: module-level SCHEMA_JSON dict + PROMPT_TEXT string + build_<mode>_prompt() builder function.
